title: recap tech collector

sources.title: Explicit public channel sources
sources.description: Objects with id, url, platform (YouTube/X/Instagram), optional name, verified channelId and official URL aliases. No account IDs or credentials.

id.title: Stable source ID
id.description: Reuse the reviewed manifest source ID.

url.title: Official public channel URL
url.description: Public HTTPS profile/channel URL, without credentials.

name.title: Source display name
name.description: Public channel label, not a guessed presenter.

channelId.title: Verified YouTube channel ID
channelId.description: Only a directly observed stable YouTube channel ID.

aliases.title: Verified official URL aliases
aliases.description: Only affirmatively researched aliases for this same channel.

dateFrom.title: Start UTC (inclusive)
dateFrom.description: ISO UTC timestamp; at most 31 days before dateTo.

executionEnabled.title: Explicitly enable this bounded run
executionEnabled.description: False produces a plan/coverage manifest only. This does not enable a recurring schedule.

budgetReservationId.title: Existing root budget reservation
budgetReservationId.description: Opaque reservation ID; required for execution. Parent application reserves the full envelope before launch.

parentMaxChargeUsd.title: Reserved parent platform ceiling (USD)
parentMaxChargeUsd.description: Launch this parent with matching or lower API maxTotalChargeUsd, at most 256MB and a 3600-second timeout.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum returned records per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: YouTube divides this across videos/Shorts/streams and reports each cap. A hit cap is incomplete coverage.

description: Explicit bounded collector setting: recap tech collector input.
